media.title: Un cocktail avec Jan Kiepura — French press clipping, 1934
media.description: French press clipping titled “Un cocktail avec Jan Kiepura,” reporting a reception given by the Alliance Cinématographique Européenne for Jan Kiepura at the Hôtel George V on 17 February 1934, and naming Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann as composers of the music for Tout pour l’Amour. Digitized on Gallica / Bibliothèque nationale de France, document bpt6k57957694, folio 56.
media.altText: French press clipping headed “Un cocktail avec Jan Kiepura.”
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The two columns reproduced here carry written reportage: “Un cocktail avec Jan Kiepura” is a composed account with reported dialogue, not a press notice. Published anonymously in L’Afrique du Nord illustrée in 1934, its French term of seventy years from publication ran out at the end of 2004, so it was protected on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright to the end of 2029. Gallica supplies the digitised page under conditions governed by French law, which exclude documents protected by a third party’s copyright and leave reuse in another country to the user. Source gallica.bnf.fr / Bibliothèque nationale de France. The local copy is reduced to 451 × 800 px.
media.publicCaption: French press item reporting a reception for Jan Kiepura and naming Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann as composers of Tout pour l’Amour.

media.title: Hôtel George-V, 31 avenue George-V, Paris — photograph, 2021
media.description: Present-day photograph of the Hôtel George-V at 31 avenue George-V, taken on 7 September 2021. The hotel opened in 1928, and its stone façade on the avenue is the building in which the 1934 reception for Jan Kiepura took place. No photograph of the hotel from the 1930s in the public domain or under an open licence has been traced.
media.altText: Colour photograph of a pale stone Paris hotel building with wrought-iron balconies on a street corner, with trees and parked cars in front.
media.publicCaption: The Hôtel George-V, Paris, opened in 1928, photographed in 2021.

timelineEvents.title: Cocktail with Jan Kiepura
timelineEvents.label: 17 Feb 1934 · Cocktail with Jan Kiepura
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper and Jurmann attended a Paris reception for Jan Kiepura as composers of Tout pour l’amour.
timelineEvents.longDescription: On 17 February 1934, Kaper attended a cocktail reception for Jan Kiepura at the George V in Paris with Walter Jurmann. A contemporary press report named them among the invited guests and identified them as the composers of the music for Tout pour l’amour.
